issues.description: Basic usage example uses `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` which is fragile and unidiomatic
issues.detail: The snippet `training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is awkward — `pipeline.nodes` is iterable/list, so users would just do `pipeline.nodes[0]` or filter by name. Recommending this pattern in docs teaches a bad habit and confuses readers about pipeline node access.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return statement
issues.detail: In the Image preview section, the comment `# Or a data URI for inline images` and the commented-out return follow an unconditional `return ImagePreview(...)`. As written it looks like both returns coexist; readers may copy-paste and be confused. Restructure as two separate function examples or use an `if/else`.

issues.description: Multiple `node(...)` examples are orphaned — not wrapped in a Pipeline and reference undefined functions
issues.detail: The Mermaid customisation and Text preview code-highlighting snippets call `node(func=process_data, ...)` and `node(func=calculate_metrics, ...)` at module level with no Pipeline wrapper and no definition of those funcs. Copying these will fail. Either embed in `Pipeline([...])` or add `# In your pipeline` framing consistent with the Basic usage block.

The doc uses British spelling throughout (`visualisations`, `serialise`, `customise`) but the CustomPreview example defines `preview_custom_visualization`. Pick one spelling convention for consistency. Minor but the Vale style file is being updated in this PR, so worth aligning.

issues.description: `polars` added to ignore.txt while `Polars` is already present — duplication suggests Vale case-sensitivity workaround without explanation
issues.detail: Adding lowercase `polars` next to existing `Polars` works around Vale's case sensitivity but isn't documented. Consider whether the lowercase usage in the doc (`from polars DataFrame`) should instead be capitalised, which would avoid the ignore-list churn.

issues.description: RELEASE.md and tests checklist items left unchecked; no release note added
issues.detail: The PR checklist explicitly leaves RELEASE.md and tests unchecked. For a docs-only change tests may be unnecessary, but a RELEASE.md entry announcing the new node preview documentation typically belongs with feature docs. Confirm whether the parent feature PR (#5317) covers this or add a note here.

review.summary: This is a docs-only PR adding extensive documentation for the experimental `preview_fn` node feature. Content is thorough and well-structured, but several code examples have copy-paste issues: orphaned `node(...)` calls outside any Pipeline, an unreachable second return in ImagePreview, and an awkward `next(...)` access pattern. Spelling is inconsistent (`visualisation` vs `visualization`) and a lowercase `polars` is added to Vale's ignore list as a workaround rather than fixing the prose. No RELEASE.md entry was added despite the checklist prompting one.
